name: GELU

x.description: Input tensor, any shape (1D-4D). Supports float32, float16, bfloat16.

y.description: Output tensor, same shape and dtype as input x.

description:
GELU activation function.

When approximate='none': GELU(x) = x * Phi(x).
When approximate='tanh': GELU(x) = 0.5 * x * (1 + Tanh(sqrt(2/pi) * (x + 0.044715 * x^3))).

Args: x (Tensor, any shape), approximate ('none'|'tanh'). Returns: Tensor, same shape.
